name: USDA Farmers Market Directory
description: The USDA's national directory of thousands of farmers markets across the United States, searchable by location to find fresh, locally-grown produce and farm products near you.
fullDescription: The USDA's national directory of thousands of farmers markets across the United States, searchable by location to find fresh, locally-grown produce and farm products near you.
whatTheyOffer:
- Searchable directory of farmers markets nationwide
- Market locations and open days/months
- Products sold at each market
- Accepted payment methods (including SNAP/EBT)
- Search by distance or by state
howToGetIt: Visit the USDA Local Food Portal's Farmers Market Directory and search by location (within 10 to 250 miles) or by state. Filter by open months, days, products, and more.
keywords: USDA, farmers market, local food, fresh produce, farm products, SNAP, EBT, market directory, local farm
